audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers say Vault (E) BLINDS you — focus.text, phases[1].why and report[5] all build the matchup around an E blind. Riot's Vault text has no blind: it dashes to you, deals damage, slows, briefly interrupts, and lands her back at max attack range. The vision-hindering effect is on Blinding Assault (Q).
audit.why: A player told the E blinds will hold his autos for it and eat the Q blind instead. The real punish pattern is the reverse: bait the Q, and treat E as the reposition-and-interrupt.
audit.corrected: Blind reattributed to Blinding Assault (Q) throughout; Vault restated as dash-interrupt-slow-reposition, with the interrupt named as a Meditate cancel and the 11s/12s cooldowns given.
sources: enemyKit Q 'mark an enemy and hinder its vision'
enemyKit E 'briefly interrupting it, and lands near her maximum Attack Range away'

edits.before: Quinn's E (Vault) — it knocks you back out of attack range AND blinds your autos, so it simultaneously cancels your on-hit trade and is her only escape from your all-in; everything you do keys off whether it is up or down.
edits.after: Quinn's E (Vault) — it dashes to you, briefly interrupts you (Meditate included), slows you, and leaves her back at max attack range, so it ends your on-hit trade and is her only escape; everything keys off whether it's up.

edits.before: Her E vault knocks you back and blinds you, blanking your follow-up autos so any level-2 trade you start with Alpha Strike loses.
edits.after: Her E vault interrupts you and leaves her at max range, so any level-2 trade you start with Alpha Strike ends with her safely kiting.

edits.before: Alpha Strike's untargetable frames can dodge her E vault knockback and any incoming CC if timed on reaction; Wuju Style's true damage ignores armor for your trade; Meditate out-sustains her single-target poke but not while you're being auto'd. Her E blind is the hard counter — it makes your on-hit autos miss, so the whole lane is timing around it.
edits.after: Alpha Strike's untargetable frames can dodge her E vault and incoming CC if timed on reaction; Wuju Style's true damage ignores armor for your trade; Meditate out-sustains her poke, but Vault briefly interrupts, so it cancels the channel outright. The blind is on Blinding Assault (Q), not on Vault — so the lane is timing around her 11s Q and 12s E.

edits.before: Quinn owns this window: her Blinding Assault (Q) hits you for a chunk and blinds your autos so your Alpha Strike (Q) is still fine but your DPS and stacking evaporate, and Vault (E) knocks you back to reset her kite.
edits.after: Quinn owns this window: Blinding Assault (Q) chunks you and hinders your vision on an 11s cooldown, and Vault (E) dashes in, interrupts you, slows you, then drops her back at max attack range with her kite reset.

edits.before: Levels 4-6 are a skill window - it comes down to whether you can respect her Vault (E) timer and avoid her Q blind. Her ultimate is a roam tool, not a duel spike, so you aren't at extra risk at 6; just track when she vaults away.
edits.after: Levels 4-6 are a skill window - Vault is 12s at rank 1 and Blinding Assault 11s, and Vault's brief interrupt cancels Meditate outright, so only channel once her E is spent. Her ult is a roam tool, not a duel spike, so 6 adds no risk.

notes: packet.suspectNames flags 'Behind Enemy Lines' — that is Quinn's real R, a false positive. The kit lists R's cooldown as 3, which is the recast/flight value rather than a usable ultimate cooldown, so I quoted no R cooldown anywhere.
